dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors, local residents, and federal land management operations within the designated national forest area in Arkansas.
dimensions.evidence: certain land in the Ouachita National Forest, which comprise approximately 2,212 acres... designated by section 3(d) of Arkansas Wilderness Act of 1984... shall be known as the 'Flatside-Bethune Wilderness'

dimensions.assessment: Imposes standard federal wilderness restrictions and administrative name changes on a specific 2,212-acre parcel of public land.
dimensions.evidence: Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to such portion of the Flatside Wilderness shall be deemed to be a reference to the Flatside-Bethune Wilderness.

dimensions.assessment: No appropriations, federal spending, or revenue changes are specified in the text.
Amends a specific section of the Arkansas Wilderness Act of 1984 to adjust geographic boundaries and titles.
dimensions.evidence: Section 3(d) of Arkansas Wilderness Act of 1984 (Public Law 98-508; 98 Stat. 2349) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanently expands and renames the federal wilderness area.
dimensions.evidence: The wilderness designated by section 3(d)... shall be known as the 'Flatside-Bethune Wilderness'.

missing_information: Management cost changes for the added acreage
importance_detail.rationale: Designates approximately 2,212 additional acres of the Ouachita National Forest as wilderness and renames the area as the Flatside-Bethune Wilderness.
